title: CiteWeft scholarly extraction and document evidence
claim_boundary: CiteWeft-compatible extraction evidence is source-implemented; no GROBID compatibility, canonicalisation or full-text production claim is made. Path presence is not behavioural proof; assertion-level traceability governs implementation claims.

assertions.statement: Pin the CiteWeft revision and feature-gate the adapter
open_gates: Compile the pinned CiteWeft dependency and adapter on supported platforms.
Run golden CiteWeft/GROBID extraction fixtures preserving spans, uncertainty and diagnostics.
Run downstream Sourceright consumer-driven compatibility and rollback tests.
assertions.permitted_claim: Some source paths implement the assertion; completeness is not claimed.
